title: Duties of Food Safety Authorities and Food Product Standards
shortDescription: What authorities must do under the Act and how product standards (identity, composition, quality) are fixed and read.
genZNote: A food standard is basically a job description for milk, butter, honey. Authority checks if it's actually doing the job — no cap.

sections.heading: Duties and Responsibilities
bullets: FSSAI: frame regulations, scientific panels, risk-based surveillance, enforcement guidance, import control (s.16).
Commissioner of Food Safety: prepare annual surveillance plan, ensure efficient implementation, license enforcement, prohibit in public interest.
Designated Officer: licence grant/suspension/cancellation, appoint inspectors, ensure analysis, sanction prosecution.
Food Safety Officer: inspect with a warrant of authority, serve improvement notices, draw samples in four parts, seal, seize unsafe food and send to a notified lab.
FBOs: comply with Schedule 4 hygiene, maintain traceability and records, initiate recall of unsafe food.

sections.heading: Food Product Standards
sections.body: Standards in the Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011 define identity (what the food is), composition (minimum/maximum constituents), contaminants and microbial limits.

table.caption: Examples of identity standards
rows: Free fatty acids, peroxide value limits

sections.heading: How Standards Are Made
sections.body: Draft by Scientific Panels → Scientific Committee review → Food Authority approval → pre-publication in the Gazette for public objections (not less than 30 days) → final notification. Standards use risk assessment, Codex benchmarks, consumption data and enforceability. Section 22 covers special foods (health supplements, nutraceuticals, FSDU), and a Proprietary Food/Novel Food route is available subject to approval.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Food safety authorities are legally bound to plan, inspect, sample, license and prosecute within defined duties, and standards specify identity, composition and quality of each food.
keyFacts: FSO draws samples in four parts; Food Analyst reports within 14 days.
Standards: Scientific Panel → Scientific Committee → Authority → draft in Gazette → final.
Cow milk min 3.2% fat/8.3% SNF; butter ≥80% fat.

highYieldFacts: Draft regulations are pre-published for objections (minimum 30 days under the Act).
Standards also fix additive and contaminant limits.
commonTraps: Do not mix Food Analyst (tests) with FSO (collects).
mustRemember: Standards: FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011.

questions.prompt: A food sample is generally divided into how many parts by the FSO?
questions.explanation: The sample is divided into four parts: one goes to the Food Analyst; the rest are kept under the Designated Officer's custody for appeal/referral analysis.

questions.prompt: Minimum milk fat in cow milk as per FSSAI standards:
questions.explanation: Cow milk: 3.2% fat and 8.3% SNF minimum.
